summary: ansible-core 2.22 removed ANSIBLE_CONNECTION_PATH, DEFAULT_LIBVIRT_LXC_NOSECLABEL, yes/no values for url/uri follow_redirects, and deprecated yum_repository parameters.
questions: Can I use follow_redirects: yes in the uri module?

answer_card.title: ansible-core 2.22 removed features
answer_card.answer_md:
- `ANSIBLE_CONNECTION_PATH` option removed.
- `DEFAULT_LIBVIRT_LXC_NOSECLABEL` option removed.
- `url`/`uri`: `yes`/`no` values for `follow_redirects` removed (use the documented choices).
- `yum_repository`: deprecated parameters removed.
